name: Modern Controls
author: Moritz Wallinger
description: Modern PC and controller controls for RAC1: WASD/mouse layout, direct mouse camera, keyboard weapon hotkeys, adjustable controller camera/aim speed, movement speed, radial deadzone, and a native in-game PC control layout.

settings.name: PC control layout
settings.description: Uses the built-in Modern Controls PC layout: WASD movement, mouse camera, Space jump, left click fire, right click Quick Select, F wrench, Ctrl/C crouch, Shift strafe, V first-person, Tab/M map, 1-8 and wheel for weapons, Esc/P pause. Gamepad remains active.

settings.name: Controller camera fine adjustment (1-100)
settings.description: 50 is normal, 75 twice and 100 three times the base axis speed. Adjustable live under Pause > Options > Camera/Kamera, replacing the original three-step camera rotation speed row; saved in-game adjustment takes precedence.

settings.name: Controller first-person aiming speed (%)
settings.description: Additional right-stick multiplier while aiming in first person.

settings.name: Movement speed (%)
settings.description: On-foot target speed, independent of camera speed and acceleration. 100% preserves the original run speed.

conflicts.reason: Modern Controls now provides its own PC keyboard/mouse layout and camera controls.
